subject: Mutual Action Plan & security gates — CardinalBank evaluation
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <procurement@cardinalbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MAP & compliance asks for procurement

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our procurement and security teams want to consolidate the mutual action plan and confirm the security gates we need to close to get an approved PO. High-level asks: SOC 2 evidence availability, SIG/CAIQ answers, DPA redline timeline, and the retention commitments for cardholder-adjacent logs.

Can you:
- Share a MAP with milestones and owners
- Confirm SOC 2 scope (in-scope systems / vendor controls) and when we can provide artifacts
- Provide a SIG/CAIQ matrix or a self-attestation we can attach to our ITAR review
- Flag any EU data residency options and retention window controls

We have an internal deadline to finalize vendor selection by Nov 20 — need to understand an expected close timeline if all gates are satisfied.

Appreciate a quick draft so we can align across security and procurement.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Senior Sourcing Manager
CardinalBank

(Attached: procurement-checklist-template.pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <procurement@cardinalbank.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 13:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & compliance asks for procurement

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf) and our SOC 2 scope summary. Key points up front:

- MAP milestones:
  1) Security intake (this week) — deliver SOC 2 summary + SIG matrix (owner: Redwood security)
  2) Evidence handoff (by Nov 10) — we’ll provide SOC 2 artifacts and CAIQ answers in staging link
  3) DPA negotiation (week of Nov 8) — legal & procurement redlines + DocuSign
  4) Final approval & PO (target Nov 18–20) — dependent on DPA and evidence acceptance

- Retention: default log retention is 90 days for request logs; we can offer configurable 180/365-day tiers for paid Dedicated/Private plans. For cardholder-adjacent logs we recommend the 180-day tier; see SOC2-scope-summary.pdf for controls mapping.

- SIG/CAIQ: attached a matrix (SIG-CAIQ-matrix.xlsx) with high-level answers; Soojin will follow up with any clarifications.

Next steps: if that timeline looks plausible, can we schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the MAP and any redline priorities? Also flag any internal approvers you want looped in on the DPA.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf; SOC2-scope-summary.pdf; SIG-CAIQ-matrix.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <procurement@cardinalbank.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & compliance asks for procurement

Hi Alicia / Rachel —

Thanks for the clear list. A few clarifications from Security that will affect evidence and acceptance:

1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a Type II report for the inference platform covering logical access, change management, and incident response. We can share the SOC 2 report under NDA; typical turnaround for artifact access is 48 hours after an NDA is in place.

2) SIG/CAIQ: The attached CAIQ matrix includes our answers at the component level. For any items flagged as partially met, we provide mitigating controls and a short remediation timeline.

3) DPA: Our standard DPA supports EU residency and includes configurable retention. Procurement redlines are expected to be reviewed by Redwood Legal and we can aim for a 48–72 hour turnaround for initial commentary.

4) Retention details: For cardholder-adjacent logs we treat PII-sensitive metadata with stricter controls — default 90 days, optional 180/365 with contractual commitment on Dedicated/Private. If Cardinal requires shorter-than-default deletion SLAs, that will be handled as a contract carveout.

I attached a short SOC 2 scope summary and the CAIQ matrix — happy to jump on the call and walk the team through the partially met items.

Sooj (Security)
Soojin Lee
Senior Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOC2-scope-summary.pdf; SIG-CAIQ-matrix.xlsx

Rachel / Soojin —

This is helpful and aligns with our internal checklist. A few quick confirmations before the call:
- We will execute an NDA today (procurement team is routing) so please prepare SOC 2 artifacts for access.

Also please include the DocuSign link for the DPA when it's ready — easier for our ops team.

Thanks — Alicia

P.S. Call scheduled for 5 Nov 2pm PT (invite sent).
